svg.title: What a pull request passes before it merges
svg.desc: A pull request changes code or a workflow. Each workflow starts only when every action that it runs, and every action that these run in turn, is one of GitHub or matches a pattern of the list in the settings as code; a workflow that names another fails to start. The required checks then pass, and CodeQL and zizmor upload their analyses of the pull request. GitHub compares each with that of main: a new alert of CodeQL of high or critical severity, or a new error, stops the merge, and so does every new alert of zizmor; an alert that main has already doesn't. Otherwise the pull request merges.
